author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The supplier contract for the next promotion week is signed, so we cannot skip the verification step. I need the shadow deployment to be fully governed before we proceed. If the shadow run lacks formal sign off, I will not approve the new model for the live forecast. This is a hard line. I am not interested in a partial review or a manual check. The system must have strict, formal governance on the shadow environment. Without that, the risk to the live pipeline is too high, and I will block the deployment entirely. Please ensure the governance controls are in place before we schedule the shadow run.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly defines the requirement for formal governance as a hard line and states that any deviation, such as partial reviews or manual checks, will result in a refusal to approve the deployment.
